input.spec:
Build an internal Expense Approval app.

Functional requirements:
- Employees sign in and submit expense claims (amount, category, description, date).
- Managers sign in, see pending claims from their team, and approve or reject each claim.
- Every action is performed by an authenticated, signed-in user — there is no public access to any data.
- The backend looks up employee and manager details (name, email, department, reporting line) from the organisation's existing corporate employee directory API.

Architecture:
- A web frontend (TypeScript / React) where users sign in and manage claims.
- A backend Expense API (Go) that stores claims and enforces the approval workflow.
- The Expense API consumes the external corporate employee directory API at runtime; that directory is not built by this project.
